[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Pertarn''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] commanding [[Rendezvous Point 4]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Pertarn masterminded the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']].
